title: A Hierarchical Onboard Vision-Language-Navigation Framework for Aerial Robots in Complex Environments
abstract: arXiv:2611.23930v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are expected to achieve semantic reasoning, intelligent decision-making, and long-horizon navigation under strict onboard constraints. While recent foundation-model-driven approaches have shown promising progress toward this goal, existing methods remain limited by challenges in 3D data availability, trajectory feasibility, long-horizon reasoning, and computational efficiency in complex environments. To bridge these gaps, we propose VLN-AR, a hierarchical vision-language-navigation (VLN) framework for aerial robots. VLN-AR decouples multimodal reasoning and low-level control, enabling structured prediction of 3D pose commands and navigation intentions that are translated into dynamically feasible actions. To mitigate data scarcity and domain gaps, we introduce a fully automated 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based pipeline to generate scalable photorealistic UAV navigation data. translated_title: 面向复杂环境中空中机器人的分层机载视觉-语言-导航框架
translated_abstract: 无人机（UAV）被期望在严格的机载约束下实现语义推理、智能决策与长程导航。尽管近期基于基础模型的方法朝这一目标取得了可喜进展，但现有方法仍受限于复杂环境中3D数据可得性、轨迹可行性、长程推理以及计算效率等方面的挑战。为弥合这些差距，我们提出了VLN-AR，一个面向空中机器人的分层视觉-语言-导航（VLN）框架。VLN-AR将多模态推理与底层控制解耦，实现对3D位姿指令和导航意图的结构化预测，并将其转化为动态可行的动作。为缓解数据稀缺与领域差距问题，我们引入了一条完全自动化的基于3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的流水线，用于生成可扩展的照片级逼真无人机导航数据。一种渐进式三阶段（训练策略，摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出分层机载视觉-语言-导航框架VLN-AR，通过解耦多模态推理与底层控制、结合全自动3DGS逼真数据生成流水线，使空中机器人在复杂环境中实现长程语义导航。
en_tdlr: VLN-AR, a hierarchical onboard vision-language-navigation framework that decouples multimodal reasoning from low-level control and leverages a fully automated 3DGS-based data generation pipeline, enabling long-horizon semantic navigation for aerial robots in complex environments.
